data.heading: Your first visit, explained
data.subheading: A few things new patients often ask us.

items.question: Do I need a referral?
items.answer: No referral is needed for physiotherapy or dietetics. Some specialist services do require a GP letter, and we will tell you when you book.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: Your Medicare or insurance card, any recent scans or reports, and comfortable clothing you can move in.

items.question: How long is an appointment?
items.answer: Initial consultations last 45 minutes. Follow-up sessions are 30 minutes.

items.question: Can I claim through private health?
items.answer: Yes. We have HICAPS terminals on site so you can claim on the spot.

items.question: What if I need to cancel?
items.answer: Please give us 24 hours notice by phone or text so we can offer your slot to someone else.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: There are six free spaces behind the clinic and street parking on Alder Lane.
